title: Sewer Reese
description: A screaming detuned reese bass in the low register: two supersaw voices smeared apart by a slow detune LFO while a ladder filter crawls from a closed growl up to a screaming open snarl and back. The drive, resonance and stereo width all travel on mutually-prime clocks so the growl never repeats the same way twice across the 32-cycle pass.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<f1 f1 ab1 c2>/2").s("supersaw")
    .detune(sine.slow(19).range(0.1, 0.9)).unison(7).spread(sine.slow(11).range(0.3, 1))
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(120, 2600)).resonance(sine.slow(23).range(8, 19)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(13).range(1, 6)).lpattack(0.02).lpdecay(0.25)
    .shape(sine.slow(17).range(0.3, 0.75)).distort("<0.4 0.8>/8")
    .vib("<0 5 8>/8").vibmod(0.4)
    .attack(0.01).decay(0.3).sustain(0.7).release(0.1)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.25, 0.75))
    .off(0.01, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.4))
    .room(0.18).gain(0.9)
)
